$comment: Shared contract for OSM-style buildings: walls plus a roof:shape roof, a replacement for fill-extrusion. Both the native Zig plugin and the maplibre-gl-js layer are tested against this file. The layout table holds the properties that change the geometry: the host evaluates them once per feature when it lays out a tile (feature expressions, and zoom at the tile's zoom), so they take no transitions and no feature-state, like core layout properties. The paint table follows fill-extrusion: `"expressions"` is "camera" (constants and zoom expressions) or "data-driven" (also feature and composite expressions, and feature-state unless `"featureState"` is false); absent means "camera". `"transition"` says whether a `<name>-transition` key is accepted; absent means true for numeric and color types and false for enums and booleans. Heights are in meters; the Simple 3D Buildings rules (3 m per level, roof:levels, min_height, building:min_level) belong in style expressions, not in the plugin.

building-roof-shape.doc: The roof:shape of the building, from StreetComplete's roof shape quest. many draws a flat roof. Alias other OSM values with a match expression. Footprints a shape cannot be built on (holes except for hipped and mansard, unresolved skeleton events, radial shapes whose center is outside the footprint's kernel, slivers) get a flat roof. A copy of a footprint that the source cut at a tile's buffer draws roofless: walls to the eaves and a flat lid there.

building-roof-orientation.doc: The roof:orientation: along runs the ridge along the longer side of the footprint's minimum-area bounding rectangle, across along the shorter one. Ignored for hipped and mansard roofs, which follow the footprint's straight skeleton, and while building-roof-direction is set.

building-roof-direction.doc: The roof:direction, in degrees clockwise from north: the direction the main roof face looks, downslope from the ridge toward the eaves. The ridge runs along the bounding rectangle side closest to perpendicular to it; skillion roofs slope exactly this way and saltbox roofs turn their long face this way. Ignored for hipped and mansard roofs, which follow the footprint's straight skeleton. Negative values leave it unset, and building-roof-orientation decides.

building-height.doc: Height of the top of the roof above the ground, as OSM height.

building-base.doc: Height of the bottom of the walls above the ground, as OSM min_height.

building-roof-height.doc: Height of the roof from the eaves to the ridge, as OSM roof:height. The walls stop at building-height minus this, and the roof is clamped to fit between building-base and building-height. Flat roofs ignore it.

building-roof-angle.doc: Slope of the roof, as OSM roof:angle. When above 0 it replaces building-roof-height with tan(angle) times the footprint's horizontal eave-to-ridge distance (half the bounding rectangle's width for most shapes), still clamped to fit the building.

building-opacity.doc: Opacity of the whole layer, applied after the buildings are drawn, so walls and roofs never show through each other.

building-translate.doc: Offset [right, down] of the buildings, in logical pixels.

building-translate-anchor.doc: Frame of building-translate: map turns it with the map, viewport keeps it relative to the screen.

building-vertical-gradient.doc: Whether the walls darken toward the ground, as fill-extrusion-vertical-gradient.
